name: SamTrans
description: Summer Youth Pass: $40 for unlimited rides June 1–August 31
fullDescription: SamTrans offers a special Summer Youth Pass for young riders, making it easy and affordable for youth to travel throughout San Mateo County during summer months.
whatTheyOffer:
- Summer Youth Pass: $40 for unlimited rides from June 1 to August 31
- Year-round youth options: $27 Local/Express Youth monthly pass, $2 Youth Day Pass
- Youth Unlimited: free fares for socioeconomically disadvantaged students through the San Mateo County Office of Education
- Great for summer activities, jobs, and recreation
howToGetIt:
1. Must be 18 years old or younger
2. Apply for a Youth Clipper card (required for youth riders)
3. Purchase the Summer Youth Pass before or during summer
4. Pass is valid June 1 through August 31
5. Bus operators may ask for proof of age
keywords: SamTrans, Summer Youth Pass, youth, San Mateo County, bus, transit, summer, kids, teens
